notes.title: Hotfix v.1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A nice new hotfix is now available for True Story Time, taking aim at several visual bugs and new quality of life functionality.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing icon.
[*] Fixed text chopping in game and result screens.
[*] Increased the text line height in game and result screens, so letter "g" on top and letter "S" in the bottom don't collide.
[/list]

[h3]Features [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a text that tells user that it is impossible to play alone for room screen.
[*] Added copy text button to result screen, so you can share your amazing story.
[/list]
